arguments.value: Three Caucasian male patients aged 53–57 with oral squamous cell carcinoma experienced recurrent microvascular free flap thrombosis and flap loss during reconstruction, prompting thrombophilia workup that revealed heterozygous factor V Leiden/APC resistance in each case.
